description: Reads a scan check_ai_visibility started in the last hour, found by the same website, city and category: the result when it is done, or how many answers are in so far. Waits up to forty seconds for a running scan. Starts nothing.

category.description: What the business is, for example "dentist" or "CRM software".

city.description: The city or area the business serves, if the website may not say.

language.description: The language to answer in, as an ISO 639-1 code: en, de, fr, es, pt, it, nl, pl, sv, da or no. Any other code answers in English.

website.description: The business's website address, for example bakery-example.com.

name: get_visibility_scan

answers.description: While running: the answers in so far.

score.description: Out of 100; null when the scan was cut short.

status.description: done: the result is here. running: read it with get_visibility_scan.

title: Read an AI visibility scan
